## Core Production Systems

### JanSamadhan — Civic Complaint Routing & Resolution
- **Description**: Production multi-agent grievance triage and routing platform built under the MeitY IndiaAI Mission fellowship. Analyzes, categorizes, and intelligently dispatches civic complaints to appropriate municipal departments with real-time verification and status tracking.
- **Live Demo**: https://jansamadhan.perkkk.dev
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Medhansh-741/JanSamadhan
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, Celery, Redis, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration.

### NyayaAI — Legal AI & RAG Case Law Research
- **Description**: High-throughput legal intelligence platform providing semantic search, case citation graph traversal, and RAG-powered statutory analysis across Indian legal jurisprudence.
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Medhansh-741/NyayaAI
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, LangChain, FAISS, PyTorch, Next.js, TypeScript, Vector Search.
